blocks.prompt: 2. Suppose we have 3 universities, and each offers 4 careers. Use a tree diagram to figure out how many possible career paths you can take.
blocks.explanation:
Pehle dekhte hain ke career path kaise banta hai: do marhalon mein. Pehle university chunni hai, phir us university ka koi career.
Find kya karna hai? Tree diagram bana kar kul career paths ginne hain.
Tree diagram kya hai? Ek tasveer jis mein har choice ek shaakh (branch) hoti hai, bilkul darakht ki tarah. Darakht ke aakhri siron (end points) ki ginti hi kul raaston ki ginti hoti hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 3 universities, har ek mein 4 careers.
Humein find karna hai: tree diagram se kul mumkin career paths.
Tareeqa: Universities ke chhote naam rakh lete hain \(U_1, U_2, U_3\) aur careers ke \(C_1, C_2, C_3, C_4\). Chhote naam rakhne se diagram saaf banta hai aur har path ek jore ki shakal mein likha ja sakta hai, jaise \(U_2C_3\).

Pehla marhala draw karein
\[\text{Start} \to U_1,\ U_2,\ U_3\]
Kyun: Shuru ke nuqte (Start) se 3 universities mein se koi bhi chuni ja sakti hai, is liye wahan se 3 shaakhein nikalti hain. Har shaakh ek university ko dikhati hai.

Doosra marhala draw karein
\[U_1 \to C_1, C_2, C_3, C_4\]
\[U_2 \to C_1, C_2, C_3, C_4\]
\[U_3 \to C_1, C_2, C_3, C_4\]
Kyun: Har university wohi 4 careers offer karti hai, is liye har university wali shaakh ke sire se 4 nayi chhoti shaakhein nikalti hain. Figure mein yeh poora darakht dikhaya gaya hai.
Dhyan dein: Careers sirf ek dafa draw kar ke teeno universities ko un se jor dena ghalat hai; har university ki apni 4 shaakhein alag draw karni hain, warna end points gin nahi sakenge.

End points ginein
\[4 + 4 + 4 = 12\]
Kyun: Har end point ek mukammal career path hai, jaise \(U_2C_3\) yani 'university 2 aur us mein career 3'. Har university se 4 end points aate hain aur universities 3 hain, to 4 teen dafa jama hua.

Tasdeeq: Fundamental Principle of Counting se
\[3 \times 4 = 12 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: University chunne ke 3 tareeqe, phir career chunne ke 4 tareeqe; yeh dono choices independent hain, is liye multiply karte hain. Ek hi number baar baar jama karna multiply karne ke barabar hai, is liye tree aur formula hamesha ek hi jawab dete hain. Chhote sawalon mein tree banayein, bare numbers mein seedha multiply karein.
